breakdown.description: The `turbulenceProperties` dictionary specifies both `simulationType LES` and a `RAS` sub-dictionary. A simulation can be either LES or RANS, but not both simultaneously in this manner.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification repeats the original error verbatim, specifying both LES and RAS sub-dictionaries simultaneously. It states 'use both Large Eddy Simulation (LES) and a Reynolds-Averaged Navier-Stokes (RANS) model simultaneously' and includes the RAS sub-dictionary with kOmegaSST. The ground truth requires only the LES configuration with Smagorinsky, with no RAS sub-dictionary.
